§b§lPROPELLANT SETS HOW HARD A CYCLE SPINS THE FAN§r
  §bgain = 176 x P x (timed / 8)§r    decay 0.5%/t    redline 12,000

§6This opens at step 7 because step 8 needs it.§r A cycle with nothing to inject is REFUSED outright - not run badly - so the PROP hatch has to hold something before the clock is worth wiring. Step 8 starts you on §bBenzene§r; everything below is the rest of the climb.

At the sustainable one cycle per second a gain HOLDS about 10.5 times itself:

  Benzene                  §8P x1.25§r   holds ~2,300
  High Octane Gasoline     §8P x1.50§r   holds ~2,800
  H8N4C2O4 Rocket Fuel     §8P x2.00§r   holds ~3,700
  Naquadah Propellant Lv 1 §8P x3.00§r   holds ~5,500
  Naquadah Propellant Lv 2 §8P x4.00§r   holds ~7,400
  §2Naquadah Propellant Lv 3 P x5.00   holds ~9,200  - the knee§r
  Naquadah Propellant Lv 4 §8P x5.50§r
  Naquadah Propellant Lv 5 §8P x6.00§r
  Naquadah Propellant Lv 6 §8P x6.50§r   holds ~11,996 = redline

§c§l"NAQUADAH PROPELLANT" IS NOT "NAQUADAH FUEL"§r
They are two different fluids and this ladder means the first one exactly.
  §2Naquadah Propellant Lv 1-6§r - §bours§r. What the injectors want.
  §cLight Naquadah Fuel§r and §cNaquadah Based Liquid Fuel MkI-MkVI§r - GoodGenerator's reactor fuels. They are the §bINPUT§r our Mixer recipes turn INTO the propellant.
Feed the fuel to an injector and nothing breaks - the plant simply scores it at the §cP x1.00§r floor, which is worse than Benzene. Read the tooltip: if it does not say §bPROPELLANT§r, it is the wrong fluid.

§e§lMAKING IT§r
Mixer, programmed circuit 5, 1,000 L of the GoodGenerator fuel plus a dust, yielding 250 L of propellant:
  Lv 1  Light Naquadah Fuel + 2x Enriched Naquadah Dust             §8(LuV)§r
  Lv 2  Naquadah Based Liquid Fuel MkI + 8x Enriched Naquadah Dust  §8(ZPM)§r
  Lv 3  Naquadah Based Liquid Fuel MkIII + 4x Adamantium Dust       §8(UV)§r
§8Lv 4-6 continue up the same family - look "Naquadah Propellant" up in NEI for the exact rung you want.§r

§e§lOR MAKE IT PROPERLY - the P-01 to P-04 chain§r
0.24.0 added a second, longer route to the §6same six fluids§r, at §bhalf the naquadah fuel per rung§r. Every Mixer recipe above is untouched and always will be; this is what to build when the fuel starts to hurt.
  §bP-01§r §8Chemical Plant t2, EV§r   §22,000 L Nitric Acid + 1,000 L Dinitrogen Tetroxide  ->  3,000 L Oxidiser Blend§r
     §8Red fuming nitric acid. EITHER N2O4 works - GT core's gas or GT++'s fluid - so a standing rocket-fuel line already feeds it.§r
  §bP-02a§r §8IsaMill§r          §28x Aluminium / Adamantium / Infinity Dust + 1x Alumina Milling Ball  ->  1x Ultrafine Powder§r
  §bP-02b§r §8Chemical Plant t2§r §21x Ultrafine Powder + 1,000 L Kerosene  ->  2,000 L Metal Slurry§r
  §bP-03§r §8Chemical Plant t3, circuit 5, Lv 1-3§r
  §bP-03h§r §8Quantum Force Transformer, circuit 1, Simple Naquadah Catalyst, Lv 4-6§r
     §2500 L naquadah fuel + 1,000 L Oxidiser Blend + slurry  ->  250 L of the rung§r §8(30s)§r
     §cCircuit 1 on the QFT half, not 5.§r §8On that machine the circuit picks WHICH OUTPUT the focus lands on, and these recipes have exactly one. Circuit 5 would name an output that does not exist and pay you nothing.§r
  §bP-04§r §8Fluid Solidifier / Fluid Extractor, LuV§r  §21,000 L of a rung + a Ball Mould  ->  a Propellant Cartridge, and 1,000 L straight back out again§r
     §8Storage and logistics, never a rung: a cartridge is worth exactly the litre count that went into it, and the Spiral chamber cannot be fed one.§r
§8250 L per cycle on every rung of both routes, which is what keeps the D-20 supply-rate balance where it was.§r

§e§lDO THIS§r
Feed the Spiral chamber's §bPROP§r Input Hatch - front wall, one course above the floor - and keep it ahead of the clock. Eight injectors, one litre each, per accepted cycle; a line that only keeps five stocked runs at 5/8 gain, permanently.

§a§lDONE WHEN§r
You tick it, once you have read the ladder and picked your rung.

§8This one is a TICK BOX on purpose. From step 8 onward your eight injectors are bolted into the chamber wall, and a gate that wanted eight in your POCKET would have made you wrench every one of them back out to satisfy a reading quest.§r

[note]Past Lv 3 the gains go deliberately LINEAR, +0.5 a level. The plant will happily drink Lv 6, but the sane stop is Lv 3 unless you are chasing a number rather than a ratio.[/note]

§8Hand injection still works and still has to hit the +/-2 tick window. An injector carrying your own timing stamp is never auto-fed, so the two styles can never double-stamp one window - and two litres in one window is still a miss, still +50 heat. A MISSED cycle now burns the eight stocked litres for nothing and says so on the HOLD line, so over-clocking costs propellant exactly as it should.§r
